checks: Root timing excludes nested and parallel overlap
Missing and unsafe timing cannot use the legacy 10ms default
Missing roots, cycles, malformed IDs and conflicting IDs refuse request outcome
Exact retries collapse; arrival order does not change the revision
Child error is observable without inventing root business failure
Conflicting status aliases and explicit errors are disclosed
No invented permissions, business result, recovery state or executable recommendations
Oversized traces return an explicit analysis limit
New APIs reject unauthenticated calls, bad pagination and absent traces
Real Node HTTP 500 and 200 requests become distinct evidenced investigations
Recorded FIN mobile traces use the same investigation path and original timing
